lines:
flowchart TD
    Start["App starts"] --> LoadSettings["Load app settings"]
    LoadSettings --> HasUsableProject{"Usable active project?"}
    HasUsableProject -- "Yes" --> LoadDashboard["Load dashboard payload"]
    LoadDashboard --> MainUI["Enter main workspace"]
    HasUsableProject -- "No" --> Onboarding["Show Create your first project"]
    Onboarding --> Browse["Optional Windows folder picker"]
    Onboarding --> DirectPath["Direct folder path entry"]
    Browse --> Validate["Validate project name and folder"]
    DirectPath --> Validate
    Validate --> Create["Create project"]
    Create --> InitDb["Create .adashi/adashi.sqlite3"]
    InitDb --> MigrateSeed["Run migrations and clean seeds"]
    MigrateSeed --> SelectProject["Persist active project"]
    SelectProject --> LoadDashboard
    Create --> CreationError["Show creation error in onboarding"]
    CreationError --> Onboarding
    Onboarding --> Cancel["Cancel"]
    Cancel --> CloseApp["Close app without main UI"]
